lists.title: Top 8 parasocial moments in Saturday morning cartoons of the 1990s
lists.dek: Every one of these is a one-sided relationship with a person who does not exist, aimed at a child, on a Saturday, before anybody had a word for it. Ranked by how well it worked.

lists.title: Top 8 parasocial moments when the reply was manufactured
lists.dek: Every reply on this list was manufactured on the near side. The far end is where it arrived from, not where it came from.

lists.title: Top 8 parasocial applications in sport
lists.dek: The bond that survives a transfer, a defeat and a change of owner. Ranked by how completely the club replaced the person.
